sig: [[["A", "Oliver, Northwind just sent a change request. They want the dashboard to export to PDF as well as Excel."], ["B", "At this stage? We're only two weeks from handover."], ["A", "I know. I've had a rough look, and I think it's about forty extra hours of work."], ["B", "Forty hours at our standard rate is, what, around six thousand dollars?"], ["A", "Right. But they've mentioned the budget's tight, so they might push back."], ["B", "Well, we could offer the PDF export as a phase-two item. That way the handover date stays on the fifteenth."], ["A", "That's an option. Or we deliver everything on the twenty-ninth, if they're willing to pay the full amount."], ["B", "Let's give them both and let them choose. Can you put together a short estimate?"], ["A", "Sure. I'll have it ready by tomorrow noon. Should I copy in their project manager?"], ["B", "Yes, please. And I'll set up a call with them on Thursday to walk through it."]], {"A": "F-US", "B": "M-GB"}]
